lines.1: 「For the school trip, you may choose England, Chongqing, Sweden, or the Appalachian Mountains.」
lines.2: 「I am in charge of England, but please choose whichever destination you prefer.」
lines.3: 「The director himself will lead the Appalachian Mountains group.」
lines.5: Apparently the martial-arts club was being forced into Appalachia.
lines.7: 「Sweden, I think. I want to see the northern lights.」
lines.10: 「Oh, right. The council doesn't have any activities today.」
lines.11: 「Yep. A day off means we can be as lovey-dovey as we want.」
lines.14: 「By the way, what are you doing for the school trip...?」
lines.15: 「Eh, China sounds good. Nothing but Chinese food, so the meals should be great.」
lines.20: 「You little--of course you can't eat pandas!」
lines.25: 「They say the water is so clear the mountains reflect on the lake like a mirror.」
lines.26: 「I'd like to see a view that beautiful with you.」
lines.28: 「Never thought you were the kind of guy who'd say something like that.」
lines.29: 「I thought it was a pretty brave thing to say.」
lines.34: 「What a terrible memory, Coconut. You really are stupid.」
lines.36: 「Yeah, but we came here to be lovey-dovey.」
